answer_1.quote: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has emerged as a cornerstone strategy for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) in complex reasoning tasks. By eliciting step-by-step inference, CoT enables LLMs to decompose intricate problems into manageable subtasks, thereby improving their problem-solving performance
answer_1.outputs: Chain-of-Thought outputs and final answers for math word problems

answer_2.quote: We evaluate TokenSkip using three widely used metrics: accuracy, the number of CoT tokens, and inference latency per sample.
